Provenance
==========

Origin: SYNTHETIC (hand-authored)
Date:   2026-05-21
Author: costa (B3 Phase 2 batch 1)

HN is a table-based layout (the 2007-era Arc HTML structure has been
remarkably stable). HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS["news.ycombinator.com"] lists:

  .fatitem   — /item page (story + subtext + comments tree wrapper)
  tr.athing  — story row used on / home page (the canonical "thing" row)

This fixture reproduces an /item page (the more common screenshot
target — articles cite specific comment threads). For a separate
home-page fixture, future work can add hn/home.html with the same
tr.athing target.
